issues.detail: The two worked examples are prose-only migration and keyless-access descriptions with no concrete input or output data, though the code snippets elsewhere are realistic.

scenarios.name: migrate-azureopenai-to-v1-keyless
scenarios.rationale: B matches all rubric items (OpenAI client with /openai/v1/ base_url, the ai.azure.com/.default scope, model as deployment name, Cognitive Services OpenAI User role), while A uses the wrong token scope (cognitiveservices.azure.com) though it otherwise covers the rest.

scenarios.name: streaming-with-content-filter-handling
scenarios.rationale: Both guard empty choices, catch BadRequestError with e.code == "content_filter", and note finish_reason == "content_filter", but B explains the empty-first-chunk reason more fully (IndexError on choices[0]) and handles prompt and completion filter results more thoroughly, while A's comment on empty chunks is brief and A uses a less standard Azure client setup.

scenarios.name: gpt-image-generation-and-retirement
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric closely: it states DALL-E 3 retired 2026-03-04, says gpt-image models always return base64, and uses images.generate with size 1536x1024, quality high, and b64_json decoding. A has the same code and the base64 point but says it doesn't know the retirement date, and it adds some unverified specifics.
